record.context_brief: first tangent-cone Betti number under interval completion
record.original_question: Let Gamma = <g1 < g2 < ... < ge> be a numerical semigroup, and let its interval completion be the numerical semigroup Gamma_tilde = <g1, g1 + 1, g1 + 2, ..., ge>. Let R_Gamma = k[[Gamma]] and G_Gamma = gr(R_Gamma), and similarly define G_{Gamma_tilde}. Is the first Betti number of the associated graded ring always monotone under interval completion, that is, does b_1(G_Gamma) <= b_1(G_{Gamma_tilde}) always hold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma = \langle g_1 < g_2 < \cdots < g_e \rangle$ be a numerical semigroup, i.e., a cofinite submonoid of $\mathbb{N}$ minimally generated by the positive integers $g_1, \ldots, g_e$ with $\gcd(g_1,\ldots,g_e)=1$. Define the interval completion of $\Gamma$ to be the numerical semigroup
$$\widetilde{\Gamma} = \langle g_1, g_1+1, g_1+2, \ldots, g_e \rangle,$$
obtained by adjoining to the generating set all integers in the interval $[g_1, g_e]$.

Fix a field $k$. For a numerical semigroup $\Lambda$, let $R_\Lambda = k[[t^a : a \in \Lambda]] \subset k[[t]]$ denote the associated numerical semigroup ring, and let $G_\Lambda = \mathrm{gr}_{\mathfrak{m}}(R_\Lambda) = \bigoplus_{n \geq 0} \mathfrak{m}^n/\mathfrak{m}^{n+1}$ denote the associated graded ring of $R_\Lambda$ with respect to its maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$ (i.e., the tangent cone). Write $b_1(G_\Lambda)$ for the first Betti number of $G_\Lambda$ as a module over the standard graded polynomial ring surjecting onto it (equivalently, the minimal number of generators of the defining ideal of $G_\Lambda$).

Prove or disprove: for every numerical semigroup $\Gamma$,
$$b_1(G_\Gamma) \;\leq\; b_1(G_{\widetilde{\Gamma}}).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The inequality is stated as a conjecture attributed to Herzog–Stamate (2014) in the literature on Betti numbers of numerical semigroup rings. Surveys by Stamate on Betti numbers for numerical semigroup rings and recent work on tangent cones (e.g., 2025 work on concatenated numerical semigroups) continue to discuss related monotonicity/periodicity questions, and no resolution of this specific monotonicity inequality under interval completion was found. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Betti numbers for numerical semigroup rings (Stamate survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of results and conjectures concerning Betti numbers of numerical semigroup rings and their tangent cones, including conjectures from Herzog–Stamate.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture appears in surveys of open problems on Betti numbers of numerical semigroup rings without a resolution.

status_evidence.title: Tangent Cones of Concatenated Numerical Semigroups (2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work studying tangent cones of numerical semigroups and Rossi-type conjectures; related open problems on Betti numbers persist.
status_evidence.claim: Recent activity on tangent cones of numerical semigroups continues; the interval-completion monotonicity conjecture is not reported as resolved.
